{{Quote|Ever been to Hutta before?''"<br />"''No. Not the surface.''"<br />"''It's vile and dangerous. I was there on a covert op two years ago. Very nearly didn't get out again.|Larin Moxla and Shigar Konshi|<ref name="FA" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] undertook a '''mission''' to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]].<ref name="FA" /> The operation occurred approximately [[3645 BBY|eight years after]] the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]],<ref name="Date" /> and saw the [[Republic Special Forces Division|Republic Special Forces]] team known as [[Blackstar Squad]] dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to perform covert activities. Hutta&mdash;a world independent from both the Republic and the Empire, under the sole control of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]&mdash;proved to be a hostile environment. Upon recalling her participation in the mission [[3643 BBY|two years later]], Special Forces [[Republic trooper|trooper]] [[Larin Moxla]] indicated that she barely escaped Hutta alive.<ref name="FA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Hutta was first mentioned by former Republic trooper Larin Moxla in [[Sean Williams]]' [[2010]] novel, ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''.
